summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs has dismissed Cambodia's claims of illegal land annexation as 'unfounded.' Spokesperson Nikorndej Balankura accused Phnom Penh of engaging in a 'disinformation campaign' and 'war propaganda.' Thailand claims Cambodia has violated the ceasefire by laying new landmines, using drones for harassment, and establishing military bases near the border months prior to the clashes. Bangkok insists that troop deployments are part of agreed de-escalation measures, not territorial occupation.
title: Thailand accuses Cambodia of 'war propaganda' amid border tensions

summary: The Thai government led by Anutin Charnvirakul plans to organize a national referendum to decide whether to cancel the 2000 MoU (land boundary) and 2001 MoU (overlapping maritime claims) with Cambodia. Critics argue the MoUs have failed to prevent conflict and compromise sovereignty. The referendum is expected to be held alongside constitutional rewriting and the upcoming general election.
title: Anutin government plans referendum on Thai-Cambodian MoUs
